title: The Other Tales - Escape Rooms
specs: Original stories and unique puzzles in each escape room
Family friendly with no scares and no strenuous physical activity
Recommended minimum age 13 years; younger kids 10-12 can play with adult supervision and easier version available
At least one player over 16 required if teens are playing
Players must be able to access second floor (no elevator) and move freely in the room
Maximum players per room: Amazing Adventure Society 10, The Anomaly 8, Once Upon A Winter 6
Can run up to three games simultaneously for up to 24 players total
All games are private; no mixing with strangers
includes: Private game experience at no extra cost
Digital waiver required for all players
blurb: Guests play private escape room games featuring original stories and unique puzzles. The games are designed for adults and teens, with easier versions available for younger kids. Each game lasts 60 minutes and is suitable for groups of 2 to the room's maximum players.
extraNote: Cancel up to 24 hours before game for full refund · Reschedule up to 4 hours before game; late rescheduling fee $30 applies if less than 4 hours · No refund or rescheduling possible within 1 hour of game start · Arrive 10 minutes before game start; late arrival may result in shortened game or cancellation with no refund · No photos or videos allowed inside the room; photo opportunity after game
